title: Steps of the tutorial (content/rules/tutorial.json, schema v0)
description: The steps are data: the order, the words of the mentor, what shows a step is due and done, and what it pays. The server moves the driver along them. Provisional, like the rules.

steps.description: In the order the driver meets them. A step starts when the one before it is done and its trigger holds, and ends when its completion holds.

phase.description: The phase of the design: 1 the first five minutes, 2 the first hour, 3 the first day, 4 the first week.

target.description: What the screen highlights while the step waits for the driver, or null for a step that needs no screen of its own.

sender.description: The made-up number the mentor writes from. It changes with every step, because the mentor is in hiding.

sms.description: At most two short messages: a greeting and the request. A step without any is carried out without being shown.

reply.description: The words of the button that answers the messages.

condition.description: A fact about the driver that the server can read: none always holds; run_started the driver has a run; lap_completed it has finished a lap; fuel_low the tank holds less than a quarter; fuel_restored it holds at least four fifths; breakdown the car stands broken down; recovered it does not; acknowledged the driver has answered the messages of the step.
